notes.title: Free DLC Available today!

notes.title: Controller Issue Fix + other news
notes.notes:
DanMachi Update

Hello Familia!

First of all, thank you very much for your support!
We have been looking at the reports of various issues and have compiled and reported them to the developers today, we hope to have good news regarding fixes for you soon! 

The patch that just came out was to fix Japanese language support.

As several people have asked, the game's main story is about 20 hours, 30 if you do all the side events. Once you've finished the story, you're looking at the same amount of time if you do the post-content story with the extra dungeons and date events.

Additionally, some of you seem to have issues depending on your anti-virus, so you might need to turn it off during download or loading the game up. 

We have heard your complaints about the controller support, and here is how to fix it.
First, click on Is It Wrong to Pick Up Girls In A Dungeon? Infinite Combate in your Steam library
Then, click on Controller Configuration like this
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/55160b9b7c152e2000b4a13ca3785cfbc034c8da.png[/img]

You will then be prompted by a screen like this, select Browse Configs

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/73ca67172b07a3f56e8144c75d1fd20057f1ccda.png[/img]

Steam will recommend you some settings. What you want to do is click on “Templates”
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/b19c1c6cf543093974f9d7866b4be77ea1beba30.png[/img]

And then select Gamepad:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/84dfc0cd945707d3bfb879b78ddab93b3aa97ae9.png[/img]

It should then do the trick, allowing you to play with your controller!


We would like to thank our loyal players for pointing out this solution in the game reviews.
Thanks again for your support, and see you soon in Orario!

notes.title: Post-story Details
notes.notes:
Hello Familia!

We're very near the launch now and we'd like to disclose a few more things about the end game.

Once the main story concludes, you unlock the Dating Mode and extra dungeons. 
Each time you complete an extra dungeon (or get to a certain floor), you earn date points. You can redeem date points to see exclusive scenes with that character that are completely new for the game. 

Each character has five date scenes and Bell and Aiz have different date point scores. So, for example, Bell and Ryu have five scenes and Aiz and Ryu have five scenes, which means you will need enough date points for Ryu’s 10 scenes if you want to watch them all. Certain characters then have “co-sleeping” or “hot spring” events which is the same sort of thing but are offered as rewards for completing the extra dungeons.

The extra dungeons are procedurally-generated and have tougher versions of all the enemies faced throughout the game (Black Minotaur instead of Minotaur, etc.). There are three of these, Grief Dungeon (Earth), Anger Dungeon (Fire), and Despair Dungeon (Water). They each have a unique appearance and five different difficulties. 

Also forgot to mention you can switch between playing as Aiz or Bell at will after completing the story!

Finally, here's Hestia flirting with Bell at the very beginning of the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/ea7683e1ab52d53aab2da750c50548d03173d8b4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Time for Aiz's moves!
notes.notes:
Hello Familia!

Today we would like to tell you a little more about Aiz, the Sword Princess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/8d9a12d312dfe6d156a9eae571b8695ecd6636ac.gif[/img]

Aiz is one of the two main character you will be able to play as in Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate. 

Let’s go together through the actions Aiz can use in Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate!

[b]Basic attacks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/6a8a82745c9196f2a1a2a88dad26d5f9680f0743.gif[/img]

Aiz has access to a long-range attack as her basic attack. She will throw a wind wave against her enemies, dealing a lot of damages. However, it is not without downside since it will deplete Aiz’s MP, so make sure not to empty her MP bar!

[b]Special attack[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/dfc34f007122be5e15f1129c89ef883758bdbb2e.gif[/img]

Like Bell’s special attack, Aiz has also access to a special attack. By spinning on herself, Aiz will inflict massive damages to every enemy around him, allowing her to get out of a dangerous situation. But be careful, there is a little cool down after each action, so make sure to use it carefully!

[b]Evasion[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/5c9fc5a53bd8f0f291e4374b5f31bab40eee434d.gif[/img]

Also like Bell, Aiz can dash everywhere to both move faster in the dungeon and avoid groups of enemies, which are stuck in their area and won't chase you. She, however, doesn't have a back flip like Bell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/f2f322b39ec728c90538497af1bb70254f91910b.gif[/img] 


[b]Support[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/c7af2e499219e0405e1df6025a68f79df1324d1f.gif[/img]

Aiz is also able to use support abilities. Each ability depends on what support you selected. As example bellow there is Riviera’s support ability. She deals huge AOE ice damage around Aiz, which will be very useful if you ever are in a dangerous situation

See you soon for the full game!

notes.title: A second look at some RPG stats...
notes.notes:
Hello Familia, 


Let's have a look at Aiz Wallenstein today!
Disclaimer: the existing screenshots are from a previous build while we test the newest PC build, and the name of Aiz has now been rectified from Ais, in order to be in line with the anime. 

Just like the anime, Aiz starts with a magic attack and Bell learns his magic attack in a later chapter. Aiz has a longsword (as seen in the cover image), and magical power, but once you complete the story mode they each unlock a great deal of different skill sheet upgrades.
Aiz starts the game with pretty high stats, as she is after all already a well-known adventurer, so her chapters usually have stronger enemies whilst Bell fights goblins and orcs and works his way up. 

After each chapter, all their base stats are automatically increased so if you forgot to increase them yourself or to equip new/upgraded equipment, you still have a chance.

Here are a couple of screenshots from Aiz's stats, items, and leveling up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/ac89ecfd93a0a220334fdfc272a706b12149e7a2.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Today we'll give you a first glance at some of the menus inside the game, specifically what things look like on Bell's side! 
As you start the game where the anime begins, Bell has no experience or skills, and therefore needs to practice compared to Aiz! 
Here is an image of Bell at the beginning of the game when he is level 1, and as he starts to equip more items to go into the dungeons, you can see a how his stats have progressed in the second screenshot! 
Bell's play style during the story mode will be more focused on dagger wielding, which you will need to increase as you progress, but don't forget that you will also be playing as Aiz, who starts with better stats and a different weapon! We will go into more details on her next time!

notes.title: Release Window
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

As there have been a lot of speculations regarding what is happening with the release of DanMachi on PC. We have in fact not announced a firm release date. The English Asian release on consoles was earlier in the year, but the PC version will be aligned with the console release in the West. 
As it happens, we have had some development delays as the staff in Japan has had to start working remotely due to the COVID-19 outbreak, and this has pushed back the game's release to this summer. 
We are almost ready to announce the final release date for the game, but in the mean time, please bear with us and we apologise for any lack of clarity in the process.
Here is an image of Hestia the Bestia to appease you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309504/bd6e634bdbf5012e9b1c4ffd28f684f96eab6372.png[/img]
